scope: Standards and persistence differential; runtime/test freeze maintained
methodology: TypeScript AST, all tracked runtime files in the listed persistence/domain/HTTP/composition roots, including unchanged files and moved bodies. Candidate calls are a conservative superset, not a claim that each is a physical database dispatch. Caller and sink layers overlap. Argument-token equality is a static control, not an executed compatibility proof.

families.review: Legacy live and already-deleted snapshots retain metadata (nested JSON, zero/false/null), workflow, ACL and created date. Actual baseline/current delete/restore both use staged CAS; revisions 0→2→4 for live round trip and backfilled 0→2 for legacy tombstone. Correct brand reads, foreign brand null, no read rewrite. Creation/transition preserve incarnation and creation fields.

ObjectId IDs/brand/join relations, string timestamps, active/loginDisabled defaults, salted password hash verification, safe credential projection and audit redaction match. Missing legacy flags decode null without read/patch materialization; name patch preserves extra JSON and createdAt.

Legacy partial attachment update preserves absent input fields, createdAt and physical extras; defaults and zero length preserved; access audit/count correct. Native GridFS bytes and Date uploadDate verified. Intentional optional stagingActorId/stagingBrandId ownership fields are the only contract changes.

Record type, form and workflow definitions retain ObjectId links and config/hidden/starting fields. Actual baseline/current workflow transition sets expected prior/current workflow, form and JSON-LD, retaining record identity.

Vocabulary/entry links remain ObjectId; lowercase fields and historical=false default unchanged. Legacy label-only patch preserves existing value/valueLower/createdAt. Figshare callers retain typed existing repository encoding.
Brand ObjectId association, nested JSON zero/false/null and unknown physical legacy fields survive replacement. New config shape unchanged; dashboard CAS advances once and rejects stale revision.

Record/user/access audits append/read with correct IDs, types and credential redaction. Chronicle summaries flow through utilities/serviceChronicle.ts to request/logger, not a new Mongo collection. Existing R14 P3 custom marker differences remain recorded, not a new finding.

changedArgumentCategories.reason: Timer/Promise sets, metric counters, Nodemailer transport or error construction; no persisted document payload.
Neutral request/log chronicle summaries replace framework access; bounded scalar summary fields. R14 chronicle-marker P3 disposition remains unchanged.

Explicit input ports/type narrowing and normalized identifiers/config replace implicit framework globals. Existing physical encoders, defaults and schema preserved; per-family repository proofs below. API/configuration normalization is intentional.

Linked-account record authorization uses existing internal mutation/CAS with brand recheck; role membership uses explicit user.id and scoped role IDs. Existing identity persistence and join shape unchanged.
Explicit repository input/type narrowing; delivery state, lease nulls, ISO timestamps and destination JSON preserved. Existing focused Mongo suite covers SIEM persistence.

Consume Readable through owned repository write lifetime; preserves attachment logical path/body, converts web/Node stream at boundary. ONI lifecycle remediation already reviewed in R14; no Mongo schema change.
Injected native collection and claim ownership/CAS preserve Date/null physical scheduling values and finished-job filter. Queue qualification belongs to parent.

Explicit service/browser/API authority, injected dependencies and delete save context replace globals; current storage mutation payload uses existing encoders/CAS. Record route targeting and authorization are parent-owned controls.

R3 staging actor/brand ownership fields/context and disk ownership replace ambient context; unsafe unknown-owner cleanup is released. Two optional persisted string fields are the complete schema delta; legacy absent fields remain readable. Accepted staging controls retained.
